معدات:Service Water Pump 
 Strainer
 2AC-BS01/3EA-B501
 Filterix Milano - Italy

This document outlines the maintenance procedure P1, which 
must be performed when ΔP = 1 bar as indicated in the above titled block

These strainers are used to purify the water, which drawn from the Nile River and 
transfer to the steam turbines auxiliaries as heat exchanger, closed cooling 
pump, and vacuum pump from impurities.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abd El Azeem, tested by eng. Mohamed Fawzy Agwa at 07 July 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abouda Elbanna, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed El Sarrag, 
approved by eng Moneer Mahmoud Al Wakeel; Damietta power station head sector, and certified by eng. Aly Al Lethy: 
EDEPC inspection and quality control head sector.

A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
فئة السلامة المناسبة,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.

Isolate the strainer mechanically 
 by close inlet & outlet valves.

De-aerate the strainer by opening 
 de-aerator valve before opening.

Drain the strainer by opening the 
 drain valve.

Be sure that the strainer is 
 completely drained and (Δ P = 0).

sections.text:
Pull off the strainer 
 by its special fixture to clean it.

Clean the strainer 
 by water jet.

Fire the strainer 
 by benzene to get rid of any plastics or rags if it is needed.
Replace the gasket if it is required.

Insert the strainer 
 in its correct position.

Close the strainer 
 cover with gasket.

Breath the air from the strainer 
 by opening the de-aerate valve, then close it.

Check the leakage and treat it by 
 re-tightening the strainer.
